steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and reagents according to the kit scale.

substeps.instruction: For 1x96 Kit: Dilute SPM Buffer with 70 mL 100% Ethanol and VHB Buffer with 28 mL 100% Ethanol per bottle; store at Room temperature.
For 4x96 Kit: Dilute SPM Buffer with 70 mL 100% Ethanol and VHB Buffer with 112 mL 100% Ethanol per bottle; store at Room temperature.

Prepare XP2 binding mix (Round 1 and Round 2): Fill a Nest 50mL Falcon Tube with the required amount of XP2 Binding Buffer (#PDR040) and Mag-Bind Particles CH (#MBPCH-50), mix well, and keep at Room temperature.
Prepare Wash 1: Fill a Nest 50mL Falcon Tube with VHB Buffer (#VHB-440) and keep at Room temperature.
Prepare Wash 2 and Wash 3: Fill Nest 50mL Falcon Tubes with SPM Buffer (#SPM-300) and keep at Room temperature.
Distribute Elution Buffer (#PDR048) evenly between 2mL tubes.
Heat Elution Buffer (#PDR048) to 70 °C using an incubator or water bath.

steps.title: Set Up Opentrons Robot
steps.instruction: Configure the Opentrons app and deck hardware.

substeps.instruction: Load labware files: denville_96_axygenbase_200ul.json and vwr_96_wellplate_1000ul.json.
Load python script: OT2_Omegabiotekfecal_v4.0.py.
Modify 'numSamps' in line 3 of the script if processing fewer than 96 samples (multiples of 8 recommended).
Autoclave NEST 1-Well Reservoirs (195 mL) and NEST 12-Well Reservoirs (15 mL) before use.
Calibrate the deck following on-screen instructions.

steps.title: Load Deck Labware
steps.instruction: Place the following plates and reservoirs in their designated slots.

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: VWR 96-Well Deep Well Plate containing 300uL of sample lysis (Lysis plate 1).
Slot 2: 96-Well PCR Plate Non-skirt (200µl) containing 200uL of sample lysis on top of an empty Nest skirted PCR Plate (Lysis plate 2).
Slot 3: Empty Nest skirted PCR Plate (Sample Elution Plate 1).
Slot 7: Opentrons Magnetic Module (holding Lysis plate 1).
Slot 10/11: NEST 1-Well Reservoirs (195 mL) for liquid waste.

steps.title: Combine Lysates and Bind DNA
steps.instruction: Merge sample lysates and bind DNA to magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of lysate from Slot 2 to Slot 7 using tips in Slot 8, mixing by aspirating and dispensing 10 µL.
Mix the samples in Slot 7 by aspirating and dispensing 10 µL.
Engage the Magnetic Module and incubate for 10 minutes to settle beads.
Gently remove the supernatant in two steps and discard into the waste reservoir in Slot 10.

steps.title: Perform Wash Cycles
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA using VHB and SPM buffers.

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: Transfer VHB Buffer (#VHB-440) from Slot 4 (wells 5-8) to Slot 7 in two 133 µL steps. Mix by aspirating/dispensing 10 µL. Incubate with magnet engaged for 4 minutes. Gently remove supernatant into Slot 10 waste.

Wash 2: Transfer SPM Buffer (#SPM-300) from Slot 4 (wells 9-12) to Slot 7 in two 133 µL steps. Mix by aspirating/dispensing 10 µL. Incubate with magnet engaged for 4 minutes. Gently remove supernatant into Slot 10 waste.

Wash 3: Transfer SPM Buffer (#SPM-300) from Slot 1 (wells 1-3) to Slot 7 in two 133 µL steps. Mix by aspirating/dispensing 10 µL. Incubate with magnet engaged for 4 minutes. Gently remove supernatant into Slot 11 waste.

steps.title: Dry Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Remove residual alcohol and dry the beads to ensure elution efficiency.

substeps.instruction: Engage the Magnetic Module for 1 minute to allow beads to air dry.
Remove excess wash buffer by aspirating 10 µL from Slot 7 and dispensing into Slot 11 waste.
Engage the Magnetic Module for a final 2 minutes until beads change from shining dark brown to light brown. Do not over-dry to avoid pellet cracking.

steps.title: Perform First Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the first fraction of DNA.

substeps.instruction: Remove 4 tubes of 70 °C Elution Buffer (#PDR048) from the incubator and pour into well 12 of Slot 1.
Transfer 60 µL of warmed buffer from Slot 1 to Slot 7 and mix by aspirating/dispensing 40 µL.
Pause for 15 minutes to incubate DNA in buffer at Room temperature.
Transfer 60 µL of each eluate to the Nest skirted PCR Plate in Slot 3 (Sample Elution Plate 1).
Disengage the Magnetic Module.

steps.title: Perform Second Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the second fraction of DNA.

substeps.instruction: Pour the remaining 2 tubes of 70 °C Elution Buffer (#PDR048) into well 12 of Slot 1.
Replace the empty non-skirted plate in Slot 2 with a new, clean Nest skirted PCR Plate (Sample Elution Plate 2).
Transfer 40 µL of warmed buffer from Slot 1 to Slot 7 and mix by aspirating/dispensing 20 µL.
Pause for 15 minutes to incubate DNA in buffer at Room temperature.
Engage the Magnetic Module for 2 minutes to settle beads.
Transfer 40 µL of each eluate to the new PCR Plate in Slot 2.
Disengage the Magnetic Module.

steps.title: Store and Clean Up
steps.instruction: Store samples and sanitize the workstation.

substeps.instruction: Seal Sample Elution Plates 1 and 2 with aluminum plate seals; store at 4 °C or -20 °C for long term.
Clean the OT2 deck and walls with 10% bleach (1 rinse), distilled water (1 rinse), and 70% alcohol (2 rinses).
Clean the OT2 module with 70% alcohol (2 rinses), avoiding electronic parts.
